feedback.end: House sparrows are one of the most common birds in the world. They are small, noisy and aggressive. Sometimes they kick other birds out of nests and move in themselves!
Female house sparrows lay 1-8 spotted eggs up to three times a year. Once the chick hatches, they stay with their parents for around 2 weeks before flying off alone.
House sparrows often build their nests close to humans - even in the sides of buildings! They have been known to nibble crumbs of human food alongside their normal diet of seeds.

atoms.a: House sparrow chicks live with their parents for 10 years.
House sparrows like to live in nests in the side of buildings.
